main_chassis_frame.title: SPCC Steel Unibody Frame
main_chassis_frame.description: Rigid 0.8 mm electro-galvanized cold-rolled steel chassis structure integrating the motherboard tray, fan mounting rails, and rear I/O framing.

tempered_glass_panel.title: Tempered Glass Left Side Panel
tempered_glass_panel.description: Full-coverage 4.0 mm tinted scratch-resistant tempered glass panel with steel reinforcement brackets and tool-less captive thumb screws.

steel_side_panel.title: Solid Steel Right Side Panel
steel_side_panel.description: Heavy-gauge solid stamped steel side panel concealing behind-the-motherboard cable management runs and 2.5" SSD mounting trays.

front_mesh_panel.title: High-Airflow Front Perforated Mesh
front_mesh_panel.description: Precision micro-perforated stamped metal intake bezel delivering unrestricted laminar airflow directly to GPU and CPU coolers.

top_dust_filter.title: Magnetic Top Dust Filter Sheet
top_dust_filter.description: Flexible ultra-fine nylon mesh filter with perimeter magnetic stripping covering top exhaust fan/radiator mounting positions.

psu_shroud.title: Full-Length PSU Basement Chamber
psu_shroud.description: Integrated steel divider isolating power supply heat and cable clutter from the main hardware bay, featuring rubber routing grommets.

motherboard_standoffs.title: ATX Motherboard Brass Standoffs
motherboard_standoffs.description: Nine pre-installed standard 6-32 UNC brass standoffs establishing ground isolation and securing standard ATX and Micro-ATX motherboards.

pcie_slot_covers.title: Ventilated PCIe Expansion Slot Covers
pcie_slot_covers.description: Seven reusable stamped steel expansion slot brackets featuring ventilation cutouts and single-screw retention.

front_io_module.title: Front I/O Interface Module
front_io_module.description: Top-front connectivity cluster featuring high-speed USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C, dual USB 3.0 Type-A, unified 3.5mm audio jack, and power button.

drive_cages.title: Modular 3.5" & 2.5" Storage Cages
drive_cages.description: Repositionable and removable dual 3.5" hard drive cage located in the lower basement with rubber vibration dampening grommets.

cable_grommets.title: Silicone Cable Routing Grommets
cable_grommets.description: Multi-segment pliable silicone grommets sealing cable pass-through openings while preventing wire insulation abrasion.

case_feet.title: Elevated Rubberized Chassis Feet
case_feet.description: Four heavy-duty elevated support feet with non-marking rubber pads ensuring clearance for bottom power supply intake ventilation.
